## Installation

<docs.Tabs sync="install">
<docs.TabItem label="CLI">

Run the command in the app module.

```sh frame="terminal" title="Terminal"
gx add collapsible
```

The command writes these files.

| File | Path in the app |
| --- | --- |
| `Collapsible.gx` | `ui/collapsible/Collapsible.gx` |
| `Collapsible.fixtures.go` | `ui/collapsible/Collapsible.fixtures.go` |

</docs.TabItem>
<docs.TabItem label="Manual">

Copy each file to its path in the app. Change each import of a registry package to the path of that package in the app.

```gx title="ui/collapsible/Collapsible.gx"
package collapsible

props {
  Summary  gx.Node
  Open     bool     = false
  Class    string   = ""
  Children gx.Node
  Attrs    gx.Attrs = nil
}

<details open={p.Open} class={gx.Cx("group", p.Class)} {...p.Attrs}>
  <summary class="inline-flex cursor-pointer list-none items-center gap-2 rounded-md outline-none focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:ring-[3px] [&::-webkit-details-marker]:hidden">{p.Summary}</summary>
  <div class="pt-2">{p.Children}</div>
</details>
```

```go title="ui/collapsible/Collapsible.fixtures.go"
package collapsible

import "github.com/alternayte/gx"

var CollapsibleFixtures = gx.Fixtures[CollapsibleProps]{
	"Open":   {Summary: gx.Text("Show details"), Open: true, Children: gx.Text("Hidden content.")},
	"Closed": {Summary: gx.Text("Show details"), Children: gx.Text("Hidden content.")},
}
```

</docs.TabItem>
</docs.Tabs>

## Usage

```gx
<collapsible.Collapsible summary={gx.Text("Show details")}>
  <p>Hidden content.</p>
</collapsible.Collapsible>
```

The panel uses the native `<details>` element.

### Open

<Example item="collapsible" name="collapsible-open" label="Collapsible: Open">

```gx

  <:summary>Show details</:summary>

```

</Example>

### Closed

## Do and don't

<docs.CardGrid>
<docs.Card title="Do">

- Use it for one optional block of content.
- Put a verb in the summary.

</docs.Card>
<docs.Card title="Don't">

- Do not hide essential content.
- Do not use a collapsible for a list of questions. Use an accordion.

</docs.Card>
</docs.CardGrid>

## Keyboard

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Moves focus to the summary. |
| Enter, Space | Opens or closes the panel. |
